description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying results. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh:
场景联动规则日志的结束时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

> 最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志。
description.en:
The end time of the scene orchestration rule logs, in seconds, specified as a UNIX timestamp.  

> You can query rule execution logs from up to the last 30 days.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; pass it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page in the return result. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. You can obtain the rule ID by invoking the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API.

description.zh:
场景联动规则日志的开始时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

> 最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志。
description.en:
The start time of the scene orchestration rule logs, in seconds, specified as a UNIX timestamp.  

> You can query rule execution logs from up to the last 30 days.

description.zh:
场景联动规则的执行结果。

- 0：表示失败。

- 1：表示成功。
description.en:
The execution result of the scene orchestration rule.  

- 0: indicates failed.  

- 1: indicates Succeeded.

title.zh: 查询场景联动规则日志

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 10.  

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
